steps.text: Speak to the Enraged Mustari by the southeast carriage for Trial of the Dragon: Bygone Legacy. Speak to the Gentle Merchant outside Snowflower Pharmacy for Deliver Hot Spring Water. Accepting the trials is free; their battles are scheduled later.

steps.label: Free bounty preparation · Recruitment Centre
steps.text: Accept The Incarnate in the Woods (Ordemos, Abandoned Path), The Apostles of the Apocalypse (Cistus, Disgraced Ruins), and The Cockatrice in the Clouds (Kokamordos, Manor of the Ascendant). Buy any missing destination reports from the town informants and confirm the destinations are marked before travelling.

steps.label: Free collection · earlier towns
steps.text: If not already collected, recheck the Grand Trad market beetle and Martira's Cattleracket Road beetle. In Martira, inspect the sack in MesmerEyes Apothecary for the later beetle. Keep a note of which pickups you actually found.

steps.label: Ingredient check before spending time
steps.text: For Sublime Spoonful, keep one Lord of the Lake, three Queen's Honey Jars and three Gauntlet Shrooms after finishing the other 20 dishes. For missing Lumibees or Dreameater Moths, check Comfort Concoctions in Grand Trad's Sunshade Row now that the later stock is available. Compare the quantities with your pending recipe list and buy the shortfall. If a cake was delayed, cook it on the next journey and hand it to the Classy Woman afterwards before planning the final recipe.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Meet Basilio for rank 6, which needs Imagination 5. If short, report any completed More tasks first; if still blocked, use this slot for Imagination and record the delayed bond.

steps.label: Night · free follow-up
steps.text: Speak to Daturam in Brilehaven's Angler's Inn Square to finish the separate Alonzo follow-up. This conversation does not consume the main night activity.

steps.label: Night · uses time · Lower Blue Sky Bridge, Altabury
steps.text: Enter the hot springs opposite Catherina for Deliver Hot Spring Water. Complete shopping and any optional MAG exchange before entering. Tomorrow you will take the water to the Gentle Merchant outside Snowflower Pharmacy on Upper Blue Sky Bridge.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Upper Blue Sky Bridge, Altabury
steps.text: Give the hot spring water to the Gentle Merchant outside Snowflower Pharmacy and collect the Gold Beetle reward.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Travel to Mt. Vulkano. Cook Sublime Spoonful if all previous recipes and ingredients are ready; confirm the cooking trophy. Finish Literacy Workbook and confirm the book trophy. Clear Wayward Shepherd, collect the relic, Gold Beetle and Rusty Greatsword before returning.

steps.label: If a recipe is still missing
steps.text: Cook the missing recipe instead, keep its ingredients on your list and finish the collection on the next travel days. Do not spend the rare ingredients on unnecessary duplicate dishes.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Sunshade Row, Grand Trad
steps.text: Give the Rusty Greatsword from Mt. Vulkano to the Ornamented Man outside Spado Smithy to complete The Edge of Glory.

steps.label: Free collection reward · Arenafront Wharf, Brilehaven
steps.text: Visit the Elderly Entomophile. To finish every reward, you need 46 Gold Beetles across this run's exchanges. Count beetles already traded this run as well as those still held; you do not need 46 left in your bag after earlier trades. Save before exchanging. If short, keep the remaining beetles and retry on 20 October after the four scheduled October pickups. Today is a check, not a guaranteed trophy date.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Basilio through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 7. Follow his request; the later completion requires Eloquence 5.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Report the Scoundrel's Hold relic to Neuras, target rank 6.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Bardon through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 8, provided his rank 7 boss was completed earlier. Otherwise this remains a recovery item for October.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Report the Mt. Vulkano relic to Neuras, target rank 7. Accept the resulting recovery request before tomorrow's trip.

steps.label: Optional
steps.text: Check the weapon and armour sale.

steps.label: Before departure
steps.text: Speak to the guard near Grand Trad's Recruitment Centre to locate Jin's runner.

steps.label: Afternoon · route
steps.text: Select Jin's runner on the map. During the journey, reread The Magical Future. Defeat Jin and watch the resulting event: Petty Thief completes and Neuras reaches rank 8 automatically. Return to town for tonight's Junah event; there is no extra city hand-in for Neuras.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Junah through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 7.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Depart from Grand Trad toward Disgraced Ruins, reread The Magical Future and collect the Malibelo Stope drawing on the route. Clear the Cistus bounty and collect the Gold Beetle.

steps.label: Optional training
steps.text: The dungeon has useful repeatable enemies for A-EXP. Train toward remaining study prerequisites and More's tasks; do not assume this is the single best farm for every build. Keep a save before the coming optional challenges.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon. Return and rest.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Recruitment Centre
steps.text: Claim the Cistus bounty reward. Basilio's quest battle belongs to his time-consuming rank-8 event below; it is not an extra free errand.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: With Basilio rank 7 complete and Eloquence 5, select his quest-marked town event. Keep him in the active battle party for the Vinca fight. This event completes A Brother's Mercy and his rank 8 together. Recovery alternative: if Hulkenberg's town rank 7 was delayed, do that today with Wisdom 4 and move Basilio's event to 14 October afternoon. Apply this swap only if Hulkenberg still needs rank 7.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Take Brigitta's rank-8 event if her earlier ranks are complete. Recovery alternative: if Heismay's town rank 7 was delayed, do that tonight with Imagination 4 and move Brigitta's event to 14 October night. Apply this swap only if Heismay still needs rank 7.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Return to the Coliseum at Brilehaven's Arenafront Wharf and complete the next ranked match. Continue your current rank ladder; do not choose an endurance Gauntlet.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Catherina through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 8.

steps.label: Archetype checkpoint
steps.text: Check the actual study menu and follower ranks. Eupha's final events are still scheduled for 05 and 07 October, so not every unlock is expected today. Train each required protagonist Archetype to rank 20 for the mastery trophy; complete trees on the other characters are optional.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Depart from Altabury toward Tower of Insolence. Reread The Magical Future and check for the Decaying Estate drawing on this first journey. Collect the Gold Beetle in the tower and complete Proof of Power's ordinary boss and Bramblethorn Baton objective before attempting the separate dragon trial higher up. Keep the pre-trip save until you have checked the drawing and quest item.

steps.label: Checkpoint
steps.text: Check Wisdom 5 before tomorrow's Eupha event, and check whether Vista Viewer has unlocked. This route's first Estate visit is based on published route information, not a tested October save; the general warning about changing travel routes does not establish a September cutoff for this drawing. If the drawing does not trigger, keep the pre-trip save and identify the missing route before spending more days. Showing drawings to Maria gives rewards but is not the drawing trophy's completion condition.

steps.label: Trial preparation · Tower of Insolence
steps.text: The optional trial caps maximum HP at 300 and reflects ordinary damage types. Bring Almighty damage or a checked method of bypassing resistance/creating weakness, plus healing and Hex protection or cures. If your team is not ready, keep the ordinary quest completion and postpone the trial to a recovery day.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon. Return and rest.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Opera House Square, Altabury
steps.text: Give the Bramblethorn Baton to the Obsessive Soldier in the southwest, near the arrival stairs, to complete Proof of Power.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Check Wisdom 5 and completion of The Wayward Shepherd, then take Eupha's town bond event to rank 7. If Wisdom is short, raise it first and record this event as delayed. Her travelling rank 8 on 07 October depends on completing this town event and its intervening gap.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Junah through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 8.

steps.label: Afternoon · travel
steps.text: Begin the two-day journey to Abandoned Path. If Hulkenberg is rank 7, take her travelling rank-8 event now. The recovery branch uses her town rank 7 from 02 October; rank 7 itself cannot be completed on the runner. If already rank 8, use the slot for an unfinished book or needed virtue.

steps.label: Night · travel
steps.text: If Heismay is rank 7, take his travelling rank-8 event. The recovery branch uses his town rank 7 from 02 October; a missing town event cannot be replaced by this runner slot. If already rank 8, choose an unfinished book or virtue. With Speed Cooking, make an unfinished dish before the main activity if the kitchen is available and you have its ingredients.

steps.label: If either town rank 7 is still missing, record both remaining events separately
steps.text: first the town event with its virtue requirement, then a later travelling rank 8 after the required gap. Keep a start-of-day save and use the remaining recovery days to arrange that sequence. Two main activities do not fit in one period.

steps.label: Afternoon · travel
steps.text: If Eupha reached rank 7 on 05 October, take her travelling rank-8 event. Wisdom 5 was required for that town rank 7. Cook any unfinished dish before the bond if the kitchen permits it. On arrival, clear Abandoned Path for Ordemos and collect its Gold Beetle. If Eupha's town event was delayed, use a book/virtue activity today and record the town-then-travel recovery sequence.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon. Return and rest.

steps.label: Bond checkpoint
steps.text: Inspect all 14 followers. Complete any delayed town events and their later travel events before spending recovery days on optional grinding. The date alone does not establish that every bond is finished.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Recruitment Centre
steps.text: Give the Recruiter Dispatcher Ordemos's Bloodstained Talon and claim The Incarnate in the Woods reward.

steps.label: Afternoon · dungeon outing
steps.text: Clear the Skybound Avatar main objective. You can return afterwards and continue the remaining October free days. Keep a separate save before the outing and follow the quest log.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Visit Manor of the Ascendant, use the travelling slot for a missing bond/virtue/book activity, defeat Kokamordos and collect the Gold Beetle.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon. Return and rest.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Recruitment Centre
steps.text: Claim the Kokamordos bounty reward.

steps.label: Afternoon · dungeon outing
steps.text: Revisit Forsaken Tower for Trial of the Dragon: Mad Mischief. Check your loadout before departing: this trial punishes nullifying or repelling defences, so do not automatically reuse equipment prepared for the fire trial. Use the journey for an eligible unfinished travel activity or cooking.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon. Return and rest.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Before departure, buy any missing mask/vessel materials identified in Akademeia's experiment menu; stock can vary by weekday. Afternoon · dungeon outing: Revisit Spire of Blind Faith for Trial of the Dragon: Heroes' Rest. Prepare Fire protection for its 9,999-damage attack and protection or cures for Charm. Rewards from the earlier two trials help; guarding alone does not solve the Fire attack. Use the journey for an eligible unfinished activity or cooking.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon. Return and rest; there is no extra town-shopping slot after this outing.

steps.label: Before departure
steps.text: Check that all three Trial of the Dragon requests are complete. They finish automatically when their bosses are defeated; no requester reports are needed. Confirm Trial of the Dragon: Essence of Power has appeared after the third victory.

steps.label: Afternoon · dungeon outing
steps.text: Save separately and visit Dragon Temple. Use its unlocked lift/teleport route to the deepest Magla Hollow and the follow-up chamber. Remove equipment that Repels or Drains/Absorbs attacks before the fight. If your party needs more preparation, use a later recovery day.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon. The follow-up request completes on victory; return and rest without searching for a separate hand-in.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Return to the Coliseum at Brilehaven's Arenafront Wharf and complete the next ranked match. Continue your current rank ladder; do not choose an endurance Gauntlet.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Once your arena rank unlocks it, complete the Gold Gauntlet's 30 consecutive battles for Coliseum Champion. Bronze and Silver endurance runs are not needed to unlock Gold; progression comes from ranked matches.

steps.label: Recovery slots
steps.text: If the 02 October recovery swaps were needed, finish Basilio's quest/rank-8 event this afternoon with Eloquence 5, and Brigitta's rank 8 tonight. Otherwise use each free period for an unfinished bond, virtue or ranked arena match. Check prerequisites and any required gap before choosing the next event. Do material shopping before a time-consuming activity.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time · Varmareno Coliseum, Arenafront Wharf
steps.text: Speak to the Spirited Receptionist and win the next ranked match. If all nine ranked slots in this route were used, this is Gold I. Certification was separate from those nine wins. Then accept/check Become Champion of the Coliseum with the Spirited Receptionist.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Complete the Champion Battle for Become Champion of the Coliseum. If earlier ranked matches were delayed, finish the remaining ladder first and move the championship to a recovery slot. This is separate from the Gold Gauntlet endurance challenge.

steps.label: Combat checkpoint
steps.text: The Synthesis trophy requires 50 different skills used in battle, not 50 repetitions. For money attacks, spend at least 100,000 reeve in total; ten uses costing 9,999 leave you ten reeve short.

steps.label: Recovery day
steps.text: If Bardon's rank-7 battle was postponed, prepare and complete The Right to Rule through his daytime bond event today; reserve 18 October afternoon for rank 8. Otherwise prioritise another unfinished request or bond. Keep the start-of-day save until you know what remains.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Recovery day. Complete a delayed boss or dungeon, or use the town slots for bonds and virtues.

steps.label: Cooking recovery, if needed
steps.text: Buy missing bugs at Comfort Concoctions on Grand Trad's Sunshade Row, common ingredients at the town food shops, and monster ingredients from Krozelli Hunter in Virga Island's Dragon Statue Plaza. If missing fish or honey, use a sea journey from Virga Island toward Land of Ceremony for Tail Bait fishing; inspect the fishing point once underway and keep the departure save until the catch is confirmed. Use 19 October for this journey if today's Bardon event is needed. For pantry shrooms, keep checking each available day; saving before opening the pantry and reloading can reroll its random reward. Make pending recipes one per available kitchen period. Count only ingredients actually in your inventory.

steps.label: Recovery day
steps.text: If Bardon reached rank 7 on 16 October, take his daytime rank-8 event. Otherwise use the day for an unfinished town bond or a runner journey for travel-only bonds, cooking or books. A town event and a journey do not share one afternoon.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Recovery day. Check all request entries and reports, including the arena and follower chains. Report completed bounties rather than leaving them pending.

steps.label: Free trophy check before spending time
steps.text: If Blessed Power is missing, take eligible equipment to St. Fermis Church in Grand Trad's Sunlumeo Street and pay to purify one item. If Shrewd Shopper is missing, buy one item visibly marked as discounted today; dates ending in 0 or 5 are Idlesday. Check the console trophy list after each action.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Recovery day. Verify seven books fully read, 21 different runner dishes cooked, all followers at rank 8, five shop villages visited and the complete vista collection. The relevant trophies/menu records are better evidence than ticking a date off this document.

steps.label: Village checklist
steps.text: Komero, Inundo, Silento, Ligno and Malva. Check map locations revealed by candidate conversations and their runner encounters as well.

steps.label: Free collection reward · Arenafront Wharf, Brilehaven
steps.text: If All That Glitters is still missing, return to the Elderly Entomophile after the October dungeon pickups. Finish his exchanges once beetles held plus beetles exchanged this run reach 46. Count the exchanges already made; do not demand 46 still held after trading. Save first. If the total is short, keep unspent beetles for further pickups or New Game Plus rather than assuming this checklist proves completion.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Recovery day. Complete missing experiments and train the protagonist's remaining Archetypes. Study prerequisites and mastery are separate: each required Archetype must reach rank 20 for mastery.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Recovery day. Finish any outstanding 50-different-Synthesis, 100 squad-ambush, 50 unscathed-win, 10 Elementa, money-skill, stealing, Gallica-chat and sword-surfing requirements. Field instant kills do not replace squad ambushes.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Recovery day. Check every outstanding request, relic report, optional trial and arena chain. Keep a separate save before entering any long dungeon.

steps.label: Recovery day
steps.text: Finish remaining activities that need free time. Tomorrow afternoon is also available for eligible final preparations; keep tomorrow night for farewell visits. Retain an older save if a completion requirement remains uncertain.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Final preparations or remaining eligible activity. Use free runner facilities if accessible.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Visit your maxed followers for their farewell items. Gallica can help you travel between them. Save separately before resting.

steps.label: Before entering
steps.text: Keep a permanent pre-finale save. Read this entry fully before fighting optional bosses in the final area.

steps.label: Trophy route
steps.text: Leave every optional boss in the final area undefeated and go to the final main objective. Defeating the final boss at full strength is the condition for Star Shatterer. Do not weaken it first. Save near the end if the game permits it.

steps.label: Optional training
steps.text: Regular enemies and the final area's tooth spawners can provide substantial rewards. If a preparation plan uses gear that repels attacks, remember that the return-run challenge has its own restrictions.

steps.label: After the required victory
steps.text: Confirm the story, full-strength and all-request trophies, then save the clear data separately. If you want to see skipped optional encounters, you may reload the pre-finale save afterwards; keep your clear data too.
